name: Shanghai Dazhong Public Utilities(Group) Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Dazhong Public Utilities(Group) Co.,Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in pipeline gas supply and sewage treatment activities in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Gas and Energy, Wastewater Treatment, Public Infrastructure Projects, Investments, Transportation Services, and Financial Services segments.
